steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thuy Giao, a water element sea serpent, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: eyes on the food, tongue flicking; (3) EAT: swallowing it whole in one gulp; (4) EAT: a lump sliding down its long neck. Row 2: (5) EAT: lying coiled up, satisfied; (6) PLAY: coiling like a spring; (7) PLAY: striking upward; (8) PLAY: an S-shape high in the air. Row 3: (9) PLAY: twisting in a corkscrew; (10) PLAY: landing coiled; (11) PLAY: tail curled into a heart shape, cheering; (12) REFUSE food: turning its head away, tongue out. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, swaying; (14) WAVE hello: waving its tail fin; (15) SAD: coiled tight, head down; (16) ANGRY: hood fins flared, hissing.
